description: Posts one synthetic lead to the connected email provider and reports the HTTP status and the time it took, so the host knows the list really answers. Side effect: one test entry appears in that provider's list, so say that before you run it; nothing on the campaign changes. Needs `session_id` and `webinar_id`. Use it right after wi_change_webinar_autoresponder and after any change to the form address.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_test_webinar_autoresponder
title: Test the connection to the email list
